post_capture_corrections.finding: A GENUINE HARDWARE NONDETERMINISM, not a tooling bug: result_colour differed between run02 and run03 for 2/25 fsredirect records (misalign_plus4: black vs red; misalign_minus1: black vs red) despite BOTH runs reporting final_status=4 (Completed, no fault) with byte-identical every other field including post_selector. This is racy even on a CLEAN completion, which the original schema (guarding result_colour only when final_status != Completed, mirroring EXP-0116's RACY_ON_FAULT_LINKSPLICE) did not anticipate.
post_capture_corrections.fix: schema.py's build_gated_fsredirect/build_addrs_fsredirect now route result_colour through _result_colour_is_racy(result), which excludes it from the gate whenever final_status != Completed OR the spliced value (mutate_value) is not exactly equal to one of the three independently-discovered natural selectors (S_RED/S_GREEN/S_BLUE) -- i.e. every misalignment/zero/far-OOR/top-bit/ceiling/near-but-invalid probe. result_colour remains gated for baseline (unmutated) and exact-natural-redirect cases, both of which reproduced byte-identically in run02/run03.
